fact: Reporting says CITADEL, the AI-for-development centre of excellence at the Université Virtuelle du Burkina Faso, received about CAD 1 million from IDRC for a second, research/action-oriented phase (CITADEL 2.0) starting April 2025.

Joseph Ki-Zerbo University's Africa Multiple centre of excellence launched the four-year Digit OACS research project on digital transition in universities in Ouagadougou, funded at about 200 million FCFA by German cooperation.
GDN's programme page lists Burkina Faso institutions (CIFOEB, CARDES, CERTIS) in research consortia on digital transformation, with proposals presented at the Cotonou forum of 7-9 July 2026.
